title: Create README workflow examples as tests
description:
Create comprehensive workflow example in README.md that serves as both documentation and automated test.

## Workflow to Cover

The example should demonstrate core pebbles functionality in a natural workflow:

1. `pebbles init` - Initialize repository
2. `pebbles list` - Show empty list
3. `pebbles new "User login" --issue-type usecase` - Create usecase
4. `pebbles list` - Show the new issue
5. `pebbles show <id>` - Show issue details
6. `pebbles new "Authentication system" --issue-type usecase` - Create feature
7. `pebbles link <feature> required_for <usecase>` - Create dependency
8. `pebbles next` - Show actionable issues
9. `pebbles new "Auth Epic" --issue-type epic` - Create epic
10. Link both issues to epic with `part_of`
11. `pebbles list --tree` - Show hierarchical structure

## Format

- Use succinct console examples with heavy elision
- Show only critical output after first full example
- Example pattern:
  ```console
  $ pebbles new "Issue" --issue-type bug
  ✓ Created issue [..]
  ...
  ```
- Elide borders, timestamps, UUIDs with `[..]` and `...`
- Focus on demonstrating command usage, not verifying every field

## Implementation

1. Create `tests/workflows/readme-example.in/.pebbles/` fixture with `.no_jj`
2. Create `tests/workflows/readme-example.trycmd` with full test
3. Extract elided version into README.md
4. Update `tests/cli_tests.rs` to include workflows directory

## Success Criteria

- README has working examples covering all listed commands
- Examples are readable and focus on essential output
- Tests verify examples actually work
- `cargo test` passes
